title: Selection Sets

story.briefing: Exactly k relays can be powered at once, no more. List every legal selection so the Core can rank them.
story.success: Every legal selection listed. The ranking begins.

description: Given an array of distinct integers and an integer k, return every selection of exactly k of them. Each selection keeps the elements in their original input order, and the selections appear in increasing lexicographic order of the positions chosen. If k is below 0 or above the number of elements, return an empty list. When k is 0, return a list containing one empty selection.
hints: At each position you either take that element or skip it, and the recursion carries how many you still need.
Two things let you stop early: having taken enough already, and having too few elements left to possibly reach k. The second is what keeps this from exploring the whole power set.

Recurse on a starting index with a partial selection. Record a copy when the partial reaches length k. Otherwise loop the remaining positions from the start index upward, taking each in turn and recursing from the next one.
